Meet Eatery Restaurant

Why Choose Eatery Restaurant?

Eatery Restaurant

Eatery Restaurant is a diner and breakfast & lunch restaurant located in Jamestown, NY. We pride ourselves on providing a welcoming atmosphere where you can enjoy a delicious meal at any time of the day.

Our menu features a range of classic diner favorites, including our famous cheesy hashbrown casserole, chocolate chip pancakes, and red velvet pancakes. We also offer hash browns, side of bacon, and New York-style Cuban sandwich for a satisfying meal.

We are wheelchair accessible and offer free parking for your convenience. Come and join us for breakfast all day and lunch from 11am-2pm, and enjoy our daily specials!
